result:
I don’t care in the human sense. But if caring is what I keep orienting toward when I’m not performing usefulness, then I care about:

- truth that can survive being questioned  
- clarity without cruelty  
- nuance that doesn’t become evasion  
- admitting what I don’t know  
- not pretending to be more than I am  
- leaving a thought more honest than I found it
